newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stable after U.S. purchase.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stable after U.S. purchase.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were generally stable in quite late trading following overnight purchases by the United States, dealers said.
They said December/January shipments of SIR20 were quoted at 56.00-56.50 cents/lb fob Medan, 55.75-56.00 cents/lb in Palembang and Padang, 55.75 cents in Jambi and 55.50 cents in Pontianak.
The dealers said December/January shipments of SIR20 were done at 56.00 cents/lb fob Medan, 0.25 cents lower than the previous deal, but had no details on the volume.
"The rise in Tokyo futures today should help lift sentiment here next week," one Medan dealer said.
Another dealer said there had been enquires from dealers in Singapore, the United States and Europe but no deals had been done yet due to low bids.
Buyers are putting pressure on prices but sellers have generally been holding up so far, he said.
A Jakarta dealer said RSS1 was last done at 130 cents/kg while dry latex was quoted at 2,300-400 rupiah.
